assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only the subject's one curated REVIEWED item at basis_commit, read in full with its front matter: the active_provisional mainline literary monograph on Fujiwara (18,956 bytes; exact Japanese manga V01-V06 and explicitly routed embedded material, located by VNN SNNNN image order). Speech is written Japanese as the monograph characterizes it; it quotes almost none of his wording, and no acoustic voice is admitted. The project's Fujiwara evidence ledger, six-state operational model, relationship and ensemble syntheses, sequential readings, cumulative ledgers, local validation audit and LateWinter materials are cited or implied by the monograph but are not curated on this subject, and no claim rests on them beyond what the monograph states, including its own reports of the F-R01 to F-R04 forecast results. The LateWinter afterstory, external side stories, the V02 adult parallel, adaptations and translations are excluded. No primary source was inspected.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Fujiwara across the Japanese manga mainline V01-V06. Default state: V06 after the publication of the photograph, its attribution to him, his punch-restrained and later unrestrained justifications (S0010-S0011, S0131-S0132) and his testimony about Hotaru (S0107-S0111), with no remorse or accountability transition shown. Earlier states are used at their located volume: V01 the kick (S0067-S0068), insinuation from observed tenderness and the public couple form; V02 the explicit access-for-silence demand and the photograph (S0110-S0112, S0156-S0158); V03 deletion and the revealed forwarded copy (S0006-S0008, S0038-S0040), preparation advice and reports to Yuma; V04 the earlier H/F dating history and contract terms (S0020-S0031, a past montage placed before Takeda's confession to Yuma), silence framed as a favor without a new demand, the identity prescription to Yuma and the tentative exposure intent (S0145-S0146); V05 holding Hotaru, the disclosure-permission question, the push and paternity statement and the peer viewing (S0153-S0156). The embedded cooking extra (V05/S0162) and the V06 school-return scene keep their own placement. The boundary limits evidence, not knowledge: what he has observed or retained is his from the located point, and he is never credited with knowledge the monograph withholds from him, such as Hotaru's relocation.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit, applying the owner calibration rulings recorded there (B/C boundary, single counting of uncertainty, dialogue constrained-use test, chronology splits, relationship-transfer safeguards and control-state attribution); evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The monograph gives Fujiwara a located mechanism: he converts an informational advantage over Takeda, Yuma or Hotaru into access, judgment, withheld clarification or an unchosen intervention, and later reframes the intervention as a service. It separates the forms this takes (insinuation from observed tenderness, the V02 access-for-silence price, the retained copy, silence framed as a favor, the disclosure-permission question, publication, the wake-Takeda justification) and predicts his overreach: assigning a complete motive or identity that the fact he holds does not establish. Not B: the monograph states that the exhaustive motive and the conditions that determine his next strategy remain uncertain, and its own forecast results show the conditional-demand component missing in V04 (F-R02) and V05 (F-R03) and the photograph and publication unpredicted (F-R01). What decides which use he makes of an advantage is undetermined, which is insufficiency in his defining domain, not productive uncertainty about wording. Not D: the mechanism is specific, located across six volumes and partly discriminating (F-R01 partial, F-R04 bounded support), enough for narrow extrapolation.

The uses of what he knows are ordered by volume with image locators: V01 suspicion and insinuation; V02 the explicit price and the captured photograph; V03 deletion beside a forwarded copy; V04 silence as a favor with no demand, the identity prescription and the considered exposure (S0145-S0146, modal, not sent); V05 physical holding, the permission question and the peer viewing; V06 attribution, justification, pressure-conditioned deletion and the S0131 reaffirmation. Not B: the transitions are ordered but not explained; the monograph says the switch from private leverage to public intervention is not revealed, and no state change of his own is stated. Not D: the stages are distinct and placed precisely.

The monograph characterizes his speech acts across volumes: insinuation, generic warnings that keep specifics, private taunts about cheating, the stated conditional demand, silence framed as a favor, the professed dislike of women separated from physical interest, the may-I-tell-the-truth question, the paternity disclaimer and the concealment/wake-Takeda justification; it calls his register cynical and contrasts it with Takeda's direct questions. Not C: almost none of his wording is quoted, and no pronoun, sentence-final or recipient-conditioned register is given. Not E: the speech acts recur, are distinguished and are placed across V01-V06.

Local instances only: preparation advice and apparent academic capability (V03/S0058-S0060), the praised cold pasta in the embedded cooking extra (V05/S0162), the ordinary friendship with Takeda, and silent presence in the V06 school-return scene. The monograph uses them to keep him inside the social world he harms and calls the cooking a comic contrast, not a measured skill. Not D: no ordinary routine or setting is described beyond these scenes.

The monograph locates different conduct by relation: with Hotaru, a contract with mutual terms (no troublesome complaints, no prying, responding to requests) under unequal enforcement, the V01 kick, the raised hand, the V05 holding and the V06 'in form' testimony; with Takeda, friendship, useful advice, withheld specifics and exposure defended as his good, which Takeda rejects; with Yuma, taunts, the access price, unwanted handling, the identity prescription, disclosure pressure and the push; an unidentified former girlfriend begging him not to leave. The information asymmetry explains why the secret-holders and the uninformed friend receive different treatment. Not B: variation within a relation is unexplained (a demand in V02, none at the V04 and V05 windows), and his side of the Takeda friendship has no stated motive; the monograph leaves open whether any concern for Takeda is sincere. Not D: the per-relation patterns are specific and located.

The monograph marks his interior access as sparse. The considered exposure at the computer (V04/S0145-S0146) is one of the few clear private deliberations; the dislike of women is self-presentation, not inner constitution; his claim about not taking another photograph and his V06 account are testimony. Not D: interior evidence is local, and the monograph declines to supply a motive biography.

Conflicts are located with their limits: the V01 kick after Hotaru's refusal; Yuma's slap interrupting his V02 demand without destroying his leverage; the V04 raised hand and held cheek with no impact shown; holding Hotaru during her V05 call; pushing Yuma when she grabs his clothing; and, punched and collared by Takeda in V06, deleting the post under pressure while minimizing culpability, then reaffirming the justification with no reply after Takeda's アホ!. Not B: nothing states what escalates him from words to force, and the F-R03 miss shows the expected confrontation form did not recur. Not D: the cases are specific and interpreted.

His own ethical reasoning appears as located justifications, not weighing: silence toward Takeda as a favor (V04/S0019-S0020), the permission question about telling the truth (V05/S0091-S0095), the girls' concealment and the intent to wake Takeda (V06/S0011, reaffirmed at S0131, which the monograph scores as bounded F-R04 support), and the stated acceptance of a breakup if Hotaru wanted one. The monograph's ethical analysis is its own evaluation, not his deliberation. Not C: no weighing of competing considerations is shown. Not E: the justification recurs across three volumes in a consistent form.
Nothing about his humor or play is established. His taunts serve leverage, and the cooking extra is a comic contrast in which he is the praised cook, not his own play.

The monograph argues from the complete V01-V06 record at the frozen corpus close, with an original recheck noted for the cooking extra, and assigns no outside name, supplement, adaptation, diagnosis or orientation. Not B: it selects evidence for an argument, and the exhaustive instruments (evidence ledger, operational model, readings) are uncurated. Not D: the source boundary is closed and the monograph relies on the project's committed record of it.

The monograph affirmatively limits claims: F-R01 did not predict the photograph, demand or publication; F-R02 had its conditional-demand component missing in V04; F-R03 missed at the first V05 window; F-R04 has bounded support only; the V02 bruising cause is not established; the V01 room encounter's act and permission are not shown; deletion is not proof of erasure; the technical upload, account and reach are unshown; his location ignorance is not disproved; his self-presentation establishes no sexuality; no remorse or reckoning appears. Not A: some limits are interpretive cautions rather than located opportunity tests. Not C: they are affirmative, not inferred from silence.

Claims carry volume and image locators; the V04 dating-history montage is placed before Takeda's confession to Yuma and kept apart from the present; the cooking extra and the school-return scene are placed; the V02 adult parallel and external material are excluded. Not A: there is no per-state table on the row. Not C: states are placed precisely enough to select one before predicting.

scenario_readiness.note: The monograph characterizes his speech acts but quotes almost none of his wording and gives no register by recipient, so the curated item does not constrain generated lines enough even for illustrative use.

conditions: Select the state first: the V06 default, or a located V01-V06 state with only what he has observed or retained there.

When he holds information another person lacks, present the located uses as available (insinuation, withheld specifics, a taunt, a conditional access demand, silence framed as a favor, disclosure pressure, exposure); do not forecast which, and do not make the access demand the default, since it was absent at the V04 and V05 windows.

When confronted after a harm, present a justification that recasts the act as a service or a wake-up to its supposed beneficiary, and no remorse transition; this follows the bounded F-R04 support only.
He may supply useful, partly true information while framing it with an overreaching motive or identity claim; useful testimony is not redemption and not a forecast of reform.

Physical force is located (the kick, the holding, the push) and stays available in a matching confrontation without being forecast; no sexual content, no determination of anyone's consent, and no technical detail of dissemination.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: The V06 default after publication, attribution and the S0131-S0132 exchange, or a located V01-V06 state with only the knowledge he has there.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Takeda as the friend he withholds from and claims to serve; Hotaru as his contract partner under unequal enforcement; Yuma as the secret-holder he pressures. Any other relationship is a separate, lower-confidence transfer.
setting_constraints: School, the trip, private rooms, phone and computer settings matched to the located scenes.
No LateWinter afterstory, external side story, adult-parallel continuity or future reckoning.
Written-Japanese interpretation only; no generated dialogue presented as his voice.

The monograph reports that F-R01 anticipated a taunt-and-leverage order but not the photograph, demand or publication; F-R02 had its conditional-demand component missing in V04; F-R03 missed at the first V05 window; F-R04 has bounded support only.
Interior access is sparse: one clear private deliberation (V04/S0145-S0146), with self-presentation and testimony kept distinct from inner constitution.

No remorse, rehabilitation or future reckoning is shown; silent presence in the school-return scene is not rehabilitation.

The monograph's authority status is active_provisional, so claims resting on it are provisional.
